source: Starfinder Tech Core pp. 184–191; verified against Archives of Nethys (2e.aonsrd.com, Starship Upgrades)

upgrades.name: Communications Overlay
text: This module incorporates digital tools, including a voice modulator and vid filter, that can disguise your communications. When you Hack Comms, you can modify your transmitted message to include simple audio and visual effects, giving anyone using the comms on your starship to communicate with the other starship a +1 item bonus on Deception checks to Lie, Intimidation checks to Demoralize, and Diplomacy checks to Gather Information or Make an Impression.

upgrades.name: Drone Shield Protocol
text: This universal protocol improves the defensive maneuvers of all drones. You can Drone Block up to twice per drone before it needs to be retrieved, with the first block destroying the drone’s shield. The battle station gains the Fetch and Fix station action.

activations.name: Fetch and Fix
activations.effect: Your drone is immediately retrieved and repaired, potentially allowing you to redeploy it before the end of the battle. If its shield was destroyed using Drone Block, it can't be deployed again for 2 rounds.

upgrades.name: Executive Escape Pod
text: This luxury escape pod is almost well equipped enough to qualify as an auxiliary starship. This set of escape pods includes a cozy sleep nook and a fabricator capable of using UPBs to create a wide range of meals; it’s custom decorated with expensive furnishings to display its owner’s wealth and status. These luxuries don’t grant any additional benefits other than a comfortable unmoored journey.

upgrades.name: Explorer Survival Pod
text: Explorer survival pods are designed for interstellar voyages into the Vast where an escape pod can float for months before it’s successfully recovered. Using a combination of extended batteries and solar panels, the pod can maintain its life support systems for up to 6 months and comes loaded with enough food and water to maintain comfortable albeit spartan conditions for its passenger for the same time span. They usually come preloaded with additional accessories to entertain passengers while they wait for pickup.

upgrades.name: Gunnery Turret Mount
text: When a mechanic is helming the gunnery, they can choose to Deploy their turret into the gunnery's space. The turret becomes a starship weapon as if it were installed in the gunnery, and its attacks affect targets on the sensor map instead of on the starship map. It uses its usual attack statistics rather than advancing as a gunnery weapon. Attacks with traits such as Ranged Shove that allow a weapon to use an action other than Strike, Area Fire, and Auto-Fire can't be used while the turret is mounted. The mechanic can only attack with a mounted turret while helming the gunnery. The mechanic can spend a single action, which has the concentrate trait, to move their turret to an adjacent space, unmounting it from the gunnery.

upgrades.name: Mine Deployment Shell
text: This upgrade allows a mechanic to plant and arm a handful of pyrotechnics drone mines as if they were Modifying their own mines. The drone console gains the Install Mine station action.

activations.name: Install Mine
activations.requirements: The drone console controls a pyrotechnics drone that hasn’t yet deployed
activations.effect: You Modify up to four of the starship mines in the pyrotechnic drone as if they were mines from your mine exocortex.

upgrades.name: Munitions Deflection Unit
text: Your gunnery uses the starship’s sensors to detect incoming bombs, missiles, and other explosives threatening your starship, allowing you to shoot them down. The battle station gains the Deflect Munitions station action.

activations.name: Deflect Munitions
activations.trigger: Your starship is targeted by a Strike or an area (burst) attack
activations.requirements: An area or automatic weapon is installed in the gunnery battle station
activations.effect: You Area Fire or Auto-Fire in the direction of the incoming fire, misleading its targeting system or causing it to impact one of your projectiles before it reaches your starship. Your starship gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Reflex saves for 1 round, including against the triggering attack.

upgrades.name: Mystic Magic Module
text: When properly attuned, this psychic lattice allows a mystic helming the magic conduit to connect with the starship and even heal it using their vitality network. The starship becomes a bonded creature in the mystic bond of the mystic who’s helming the battle station for the duration they’re helming it. The magic conduit battle station gains the Transmute Vitality station action.

activations.name: Transmute Vitality
activations.effect: You Transfer Vitality to repair your starship, restoring its Hull Points instead of Hit Points.

upgrades.name: Ordnance Hinges
text: This deceptively simple mounting system includes integrated hydraulic shocks and locks that allow you to reposition heavy artillery with ease. The battle station gains the Rotate Armament station action.

activations.name: Rotate Armament
activations.requirements: An ordnance weapon is installed in the gunnery battle station
activations.effect: For the rest of the turn, you can fire the weapon installed in your gunnery in any direction, ignoring the starship’s heading.

upgrades.name: Powerful Thrusters
text: These powerful thrusters can be safely overloaded when a starship needs extra speed. The pilot’s console gains the Overload Thrusters station action.

activations.name: Overload Thrusters
activations.effect: Your starship gains a +1-zone status bonus to its Speed until the start of your next turn.

upgrades.name: Rotational Thrusters
text: These thrusters are mounted on rotating bases that allow for exceptionally sharp turns. The pilot’s console gains the Uncanny Turn station action.

activations.name: Uncanny Turn
activations.effect: Using your rotational thrusters, you Change Heading at a moment's notice. You can decide whether to use this action before or after the triggering Boost Thrusters action.

upgrades.name: Secondary Armaments
text: You can install a second weapon in the gunnery. You can select one active weapon at a time, which counts as your gunnery weapon. You choose which weapon is active when you start helming the gunnery. You can switch your active weapon as an Interact action, which is a station action with the manipulate trait, while helming the gunnery.

upgrades.name: Security Relay
text: These scanners pair with flat disks that are installed in every room and corridor aboard a given starship, allowing for different forms of detection that can locate even the best disguised infiltrators. The scanners gain the Security Scan station action.

activations.name: Security Scan
activations.effect: You scan your starship for signs of intruders, including incorporeal creatures and stowaways. The scanners display a full map of the starship with the locations of all onboard creatures, including names of all crew registered with the starship. The GM attempts a secret Computers check against the Stealth DCs of any creatures aboard your starship attempting to hide from your scanner and against the Deception DCs of any creatures aboard your starship attempting to disguise themselves as a member of your crew. On a success, the scanner identifies the creature as an intruder and displays them as such on your map; you can immediately Point Out creatures detected in this way as a free action. On a failure, hidden creatures don’t appear on the map, and creatures disguised as a member of the crew are mislabeled as that crew member (so that crew member would be displayed twice on the map).

variants.name: Security Relay (Tactical)
text: In addition to its normal effects, you can detect hazards with Security Scan. Compare the Computers check of your Security Scan against the Stealth DC of any hazards aboard your starship.

upgrades.name: Tangle Ward
text: A tangle ward is an automated magical defense matrix designed to snare boarders and intruders as soon as they set foot in the starship. The magic conduit gains the Snare Boarders station reaction.

activations.name: Snare Boarders
activations.effect: The tangle ward creates difficult terrain on all surfaces in a 20-foot burst. The burst can appear anywhere on your starship and lasts for 1 round. Any creatures affected by the burst take a –1 circumstance penalty to initiative rolls.

variants.name: Tangle Ward (Tactical)
text: In addition to creating difficult terrain, the tangle ward forces affected targets to attempt a Reflex save against your spell DC. Speeds for 1 round. Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to Escape against your spell DC to remove the immobilized condition.
variants.reviewNote: The source text is reproduced as published (Tech Core p. 188 / Archives of Nethys); part of the sentence about the Reflex save outcome appears to be missing ("Speeds for 1 round. Speeds for 1 round."). Check the book before use.

variants.name: Tangle Ward (Advanced)
text: As tactical, except the effects last for 2 rounds.

variants.name: Tangle Ward (Superior)
text: As tactical, except the effects last for 1 minute.

upgrades.name: Technomancer Magic Module
text: Resembling a three-dimensional computer with arcane glyphs instead of keys, this addition to an existing magic conduit allows technomancers to hack spells installed in the console. The magic conduit gains the Overclock Magic Conduit station action.

activations.name: Overclock Magic Conduit
activations.trigger: You Cast a Spell using a spell slot
activations.effect: You overclock the magic conduit battle station. This counts as overclocked gear. When you cast a starship spell that deals acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage while the battle station is overclocked, you can change the damage type to acid, cold, electricity, or fire.

variants.name: Technomancer Magic Module (Tactical)
text: As commercial, and the magic conduit battle station gains the Overclock Shielding station action.

activations.name: Overclock Shielding
activations.requirements: The magic conduit battle station is overclocked
activations.effect: The first time the starship gains Shield Points before the end of your next turn, increase the amount gained by your level.

upgrades.name: Witchwarper Magic Module
text: Said to exist in multiple worlds at once, the witchwarper magic module is a magical orrery with planets constantly shifting position in mysterious patterns. The magic conduit gains the Warp Space and Time station action.

activations.name: Warp Space and Time
activations.effect: You create a 1-zone burst centered on a point you choose within your starship’s sensor range. The otherworldly terrain in the burst reduces enemy Speed by 1 zone, and you can always Stick to Cover in this region. You can reposition your quantum field as a single action, which is a station action with the manipulate trait, while helming the magic conduit.

upgrades.name: Gravity Toggle
text: This upgrade controls the starship’s artificial gravity settings. The generator battle station gains the Switch Gravity action.

activations.name: Switch Gravity
activations.effect: You disable or enable the artificial gravity on board the starship, causing the interior to become zero gravity or return to its default gravity (typically standard gravity).

upgrades.name: Mechanic Generator Module
text: A customized panel with wireless capability syncs with the user’s neocortex, allowing a mechanic to adjust the starship’s systems on the fly. The generator gains the Modify Starship station action.

activations.name: Modify Starship
activations.effect: While helming the generator, you apply one of the following mods to another battle station on your starship. The battle station remains modded until the end of your next turn.

details.label: Amplify Output (magic conduit)
details.text: The first time each round that the magic conduit restores Hull Points or Shield Points, or deals damage, it increases the amount by your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1).

details.label: Comprehensive Shielding (generator)
details.text: When the starship gains Shield Points using a generator station action, it gains additional Shield Points equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1).

details.label: Explosive Drones (drone console)
details.text: Immediately after you Drone Block, you can send the destroyed drone's remains hurtling toward a starship with a range of 1 zone, dealing piercing damage to the target starship equal to your level with a basic Reflex save against your mechanic class DC.

details.label: Malware Injector (scanners)
details.text: When the scanners identify a battle station on another starship, the target starship also becomes clumsy 1 for 1 round.

details.label: Revamp Weaponry (gunnery)
details.text: Apply a weapon modification you know to a weapon installed in a gunnery.

details.label: Thruster Flare (pilot's console)
details.text: When your starship uses Boost Thrusters, deal fire damage equal to your level to every other starship in the same zone as your starship (before you move) with a basic Reflex save against your mechanic class DC.

upgrades.name: Pulse Shield
text: This additional component shielding allows you to overload your generator without destroying the critical systems aboard your starship. The generator gains the Shield Pulse station action.

activations.name: Shield Pulse
activations.requirements: Your Shield Points are at full capacity
activations.effect: Lose any number of Shield Points up to your starship’s current total (your choice). Every other starship in your starship’s zone takes electricity damage equal to the amount of Shield Points you expended this way with a basic Fortitude save against your Crafting DC.

variants.name: Pulse Shield (Tactical)
text: When you activate Shield Pulse, choose whether to exclude starships in your zone or increase the range to 1 zone.

variants.name: Pulse Shield (Advanced)
text: Increase the range of your Shield Pulse to 2 zones.

upgrades.name: Solar Generator Crystal
upgrades.usage: Installed in a generator on a starship with a ramming prow
text: This crystal allows a solarian to generate a solar shield around a starship. The generator gains the Nova Shield station action.

activations.name: Nova Shield
activations.effect: You manifest your solar shield around the hull of a starship within sensor range. You grant 1d8 Shield Points to your target. At 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter, increase the number of Shield Points you grant the starship by 1d8. Additionally, your starship has a +1 circumstance bonus to its AC until your Shield Points are reduced to 0 or until 1 minute passes, whichever happens first.

upgrades.reviewNote: The usage line is reproduced as printed ("installed in a generator on a starship with a ramming prow"). The module offers it for generators and does not check for a ramming prow.

upgrades.name: Starship Weapon Crystal
text: This upgrade resembles a large solarian crystal that hums to life, glowing and floating when a solarian is nearby. When installed in a gunnery, it allows a solarian to unleash their solar armaments against other starships, amplifying their strength to contend with starships. The gunnery gains the following station actions.

activations.name: Nova Weapon
activations.effect: You channel the power of the stars to manifest weapons scaled to the starship's size. You use your solar weapon's statistics and your Strength to calculate its attack modifier and damage. Your nova weapon also benefits from your solar weapon's core solarian crystals and orbital solarian crystals. If your solar weapon has the reach property, the nova weapon doesn't have it and instead has d10 damage die. The nova weapon otherwise acts as your solar weapon. Choose graviton-attuned or photon-attuned when you use this action.

details.label: Graviton-Attuned
details.text: When you successfully Strike a starship using your nova weapon, that starship takes a –1-zone circumstance penalty to its Speed until the end of its next turn.

details.label: Photon-Attuned
details.text: When you successfully Strike a starship with your nova weapon, you deal an additional amount of fire damage equal to half your level (rounded up).

activations.name: Nova Strike
activations.effect: Make a melee Strike with the nova weapon against another starship in the same zone as your starship.

variants.name: Starship Weapon Crystal (Tactical)
text: When you manifest your nova weapon, you also manifest a nova flare, which is a martial ranged starship weapon in the brawling group with the attuned and solarian traits. It benefits from your solar flare's solarian crystals.

activations.name: Nova Blast
activations.effect: Make a ranged nova flare Strike against a target on the sensor map. You add your Strength modifier to damage rolls with your nova flare.

details.label: Graviton-Attuned
details.text: 1d8 bludgeoning, range increment 2 zones. On a critical success, the target is off-kilter and reduces its Speed by 1 zone for 1 round until the beginning of your turn.

details.label: Photon-Attuned
details.text: 1d6 fire, range increment 4 zones. On a critical success, the target takes an additional 1d6 persistent fire damage.

variants.name: Starship Weapon Crystal (Advanced)
text: The gunnery gains the following station action.

activations.name: Nova Surge
activations.trigger: A starship in your zone performs a move action, or a starship leaves your zone
activations.effect: Make a Nova Strike with your nova weapon against the triggering foe. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

upgrades.name: Thasteron Afterburner
text: Thasteron is an inefficient, plentiful, and highly combustible source of energy utilized by this upgrade to accelerate the starship with a dangerous explosion. The thasteron afterburner integrates a fuel tank that empties when the upgrade is activated and can be reloaded with a single Interact action by anyone adjacent to the pilot’s console. The pilot’s console gains the Thasteron Burst action.

activations.name: Thasteron Burst
activations.effect: Boost Thrusters. Your starship gains a +1-zone status bonus to Speed during this action. Any other starships in your original zone must succeed at a basic Fortitude save against your Piloting DC or take 1d12 fire damage.

variants.name: Thasteron Afterburner (Tactical)
text: Thasteron Burst deals 2d12 fire damage.

variants.name: Thasteron Afterburner (Advanced)
text: Thasteron Burst deals 3d12 fire damage.

variants.name: Thasteron Afterburner (Superior)
text: Thasteron Burst deals 8d12 fire damage.

variants.name: Thasteron Afterburner (Elite)
text: Thasteron Burst deals 10d12 fire damage.

variants.name: Thasteron Afterburner (Ultimate)
text: Thasteron Burst deals 12d12 fire damage.

variants.name: Thasteron Afterburner (Paragon)
text: Thasteron Burst deals 14d12 fire damage and grants a +2-zone status bonus to Speed.

upgrades.name: Towing Winch
text: This cable is designed to haul cargo larger than the starship, such as other starships that have lost power or are nonfunctional. The gunnery gains the Connect Tow Cable station action.

activations.name: Connect Tow Cable
activations.requirements: Another starship is in the same zone as your starship
activations.effect: Make a ranged Strike against the target. On a success, you and the target are connected to each other by an adamantine tow cable. If one of the connected starships is smaller than the other, the smaller starship can’t move outside the larger starship’s zone, and when the larger starship moves to another zone, the smaller starship moves to the same zone with it. If a starship is the same size as or larger than the other, it costs an additional 1 zone of movement for it to move 1 zone. You can retract the tow cable as a single action, which has the manipulate and station traits, to disconnect the starships. A starship with a Speed of at least 1 zone can Escape being connected in this way by succeeding at a Fortitude save against your starship’s Fortitude DC. On a success, the starship is freed. On a critical success, your towing winch upgrade is broken.

upgrades.name: Solar Thrusters
text: The pilot console gains the Nova Dash station action.

activations.name: Nova Dash
activations.effect: You zoom forward with a blast of stellar energy. You Boost Thrusters up to twice your Speed with a +1-zone status bonus to your Speed.

details.label: Graviton-Attuned
details.text: After your movement, enemies in your zone must attempt a Fortitude save against your solarian DC. On a failure, they’re off-kilter for 1 round.

details.label: Photon-Attuned
details.text: After your movement, you create a photon field in your zone. Until the start of your next turn, starships outside the zone are concealed to starships in the zone.

upgrades.name: Magnepod
text: Magnepods are escape pods that can attach themselves to other starships using auxiliary boosters and powerful magnets. While originally intended for passengers who require specific environments to survive that might not be commonplace where their starship is traveling, these pods are a favorite of space pirates, smugglers, and other criminals who use them to hitch a ride back to civilization aboard the vessel responsible for their starship’s destruction.

upgrades.name: Operator's Switchboard
text: This switchboard is a mishmash of complex wiring and levers designed to manually transmit power through a starship using a combination of technical knowhow and masterful finesse.

activations.name: Efficient Boost
activations.effect: Boost Battle Station twice.

upgrades.name: Pet Drone Shell
text: A pet drone shell is a small cockpit that fits a single Tiny creature that can transmit a creature’s thoughts to drones controlled by the drone console. This allows creatures that would otherwise be unable to helm the drone console to increase your efficiency. The drone console gains the Onboard Pet station action.

activations.name: Onboard Pet
activations.requirements: You have a Tiny animal companion, familiar, pet, or robot companion adjacent to the battle station
activations.effect: Your minion enters a small cockpit at the drone console’s base. Your minion assists you in piloting the drones. You become quickened for 1 minute, until you stop helming the battle station, until your minion is reduced to 0 Hit Points, or it’s no longer in its cockpit, whichever happens first. You can use the extra action only to perform station actions granted by the drone console. You can Dismiss this effect. When the effect ends, your minion exits the cockpit.

upgrades.name: Tractor Beam
text: A tractor beam uses gravitons to pull mass toward the starship without exerting force on the starship itself, drawing upon the power of the generator as fuel. The generator gains the Pull Starship station action.

activations.name: Pull Starship
activations.requirements: The target can’t be larger than your starship and must be within sensor range
activations.effect: The target must attempt a Fortitude save against your Crafting DC.

details.label: Success
details.text: The target takes a –1-zone status penalty to its Speed for 1 round.

details.label: Failure
details.text: The target is pulled 1 zone closer to your starship, and takes a –1-zone status penalty to its Speed for 1 round.

details.label: Critical Failure
details.text: The target is pulled 2 zones closer to your starship and takes a –2-zone status penalty to its Speed for 1 round.

upgrades.name: Nova Prow
text: The pilot console gains the Nova Ram station action.

activations.name: Nova Ram
activations.effect: You manifest your solar weapon across the prow of the starship. You Boost Thrusters, and if your starship moves at least 1 zone, it can then collide with a target in its zone. Creatures on board your starship must attempt a Reflex save against your solarian class DC; on a failure, they're knocked prone, but a creature helming a station is instead off-guard until the start of its next turn on a failure. A nova prow has no effect on a target that's at least two sizes larger than your starship.

details.label: Graviton-Attuned
details.text: The target takes 2d8 bludgeoning damage with a basic Fortitude save against your solarian class DC. A starship that fails this save is also pushed 1 zone in the direction of your heading (2 zones on a critical failure).

details.label: Photon-Attuned
details.text: The target takes 2d8 fire damage with a basic Reflex save against your solarian class DC. A starship that fails this save is dazzled for 1 round (2 rounds on a critical failure).

variants.name: Nova Prow (Tactical)
text: The nova prow can affect starships up to two sizes larger and deals 4d8 damage.

variants.name: Nova Prow (Advanced)
text: The nova prow can affect starships of any size and deals 6d8 damage.

variants.name: Nova Prow (Superior)
text: The nova prow can affect starships of any size and deals 8d8 damage.

variants.name: Nova Prow (Elite)
text: The nova prow can affect starships of any size and deals 10d8 damage.

upgrades.name: Primal Shielding
text: A seed infused with primal energy has grown into a tree entwined around the starship's generator. While not sapient enough to run the battle station on its own, the tree passively maintains the starship's life support systems and environmental protections even if the rest of the starship is inoperable or if the generator is malfunctioning. The generator battle station gains the Shielding Foliage station reaction, which can be used even while the generator is malfunctioning.

activations.name: Shielding Foliage
activations.trigger: Your starship takes damage and has 0 Shield Points
activations.effect: Foliage shields the hull, granting resistance equal to your starship’s level against the type of damage dealt by the triggering attack. The resistance lasts for 1 minute.

upgrades.name: Ramming Prow
text: The pilot’s console gains the Ram station action.

activations.name: Ram
activations.effect: Your starship Boosts Thrusters in its current heading. If it moves at least 1 zone, it can then collide with a target in its zone. The target takes 2d8 bludgeoning damage with a basic Fortitude save against your Piloting DC. A starship that fails this save is also pushed 1 zone (2 zones on a critical failure). Creatures on board your starship must attempt a Reflex save against your Piloting DC; on a failure, they're knocked prone, but a creature helming a station is instead off-guard until the start of its next turn on a failure. A ramming prow has no effect on a target that's at least two sizes larger than your starship.

variants.name: Ramming Prow (Tactical)
text: The ramming prow can affect starships up to two sizes larger and deals 4d8 damage.

variants.name: Ramming Prow (Advanced)
text: The ramming prow can affect starships of any size and deals 6d8 damage.

variants.name: Ramming Prow (Superior)
text: The ramming prow can affect starships of any size and deals 8d8 damage.

variants.name: Ramming Prow (Elite)
text: The ramming prow can affect starships of any size and deals 10d8 damage.

upgrades.name: Cloaking Unit
text: This device allows a starship to temporarily vanish from sensor maps. The scanners gain the Cloak Starship station action.

activations.name: Cloak Starship
activations.effect: The starship emits waves that counter starship sensors. It becomes invisible for 1 hour. This makes it undetected to all starships, though starships can attempt to find the target, such as with Seek Starships. If the invisible starship uses a hostile action, the invisibility ends after that action is completed.

variants.name: Cloaking Unit (Tactical)
text: The frequency becomes three times per day.

upgrades.name: Telepod
text: Telepods can translocate up to three times, instantly traveling a distance that a standard starship engine would travel in 1d4 days. While intended to get a crew close enough to their home planet to be picked up within hours instead of weeks, the escape pods are also used to flee enemies who are more interested in the starship's passengers than ransacking a disabled starship.

upgrades.name: Interplanar Pod
text: Interplanar pods are designed for starships exploring other planes. Instead of launching from the starship like a normal escape pod, interplanar pods return to the Universe using an embedded planar displacement ritual circuit, safely transporting all passengers to a location designated when the ritual was cast. Once used, an interplanar pod becomes inert and can't be repaired.
